A FEW THINGS TO KNOW

Before the good times.

Can you cater for my event size?

We plan packages for small gatherings, large celebrations and everything in between. Share your guest count and drinks plan so we can discuss a suitable setup.

Can I include ice and delivery?

Ask about ice, delivery, setup and collection in your enquiry. The available options, timings and costs will be agreed in your quote.

Is sending an enquiry a confirmed booking?

No. Your booking is confirmed only after availability, your package and payment arrangements have been agreed. This preview’s planner does not send enquiries.
